A new character: an amateur football player, a white man in his mid thirties, a scruffy, easy-going running back: medium height, stocky and solid with a deep chest, strong freckled forearms and thick strong legs, pale freckled sunburnt skin, a messy mop of rust-red hair, a short scruffy rust-red beard, a snub nose, pale eyebrows, a lopsided, relaxed closed-mouth grin, wearing royal blue sneakers. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees.
